title: Đúng
summary: Use Đúng when you want to confirm that something is correct.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Đúng means yes in the sense of correct or right. Use it when someone checks a name, room number, pickup place, price, order, or direction and you want to confirm they have it right. It is different from Có, which often answers whether something exists or is available.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Say Đúng when the other person is checking a fact and you want a short confirmation.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: The word points to correctness, not just agreement.

breakdown.english: right / correct; yes, that is correct

sections.title: Nearby answers
sections.body: Choose the answer by the kind of question you heard.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it when staff point to your booking name, a driver repeats the destination, a cashier confirms the item, or someone asks whether a detail is correct.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: For extra politeness, Dạ đúng is natural in many adult service moments, but Đúng by itself is still clear when the exchange is quick.
